capabilities: Coach a paragraph or whole note with reader-perspective notes
Quote and mark the exact words each note is about in the editor
Suggest one edit from a bank of 170 craft cards
Run inference on a user-chosen OpenAI-compatible model server such as Ollama
Navigate, re-coach, and dismiss notes from a side panel and hotkeys
disambiguation: Not a grammar checker or auto-editor; it suggests one edit per paragraph but never writes or replaces your sentences.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later on desktop. Downloads a ~244 MB embedding model (EmbeddingGemma) and ONNX runtime on request, hash-checked. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get reader-perspective feedback on prose; writers must judge their own paragraphs alone.

relations.evidence: It uses a language model on a server you choose, such as Ollama.
Card search: EmbeddingGemma, under the Gemma terms of use, run by Transformers.js.

requires.name: language model server such as Ollama
API key, only if the server needs one

summary: Paragraph coach that gives editor-style notes on your writing: what a reader takes from it, and one craft edit to try, without rewriting prose.
